paragraphs.source_en: It is well to give when asked, but it is better to give unasked, through understanding;

units.source_en: It is well to give when asked, but it is better to give unasked, through understanding;

paragraphs.source_en: And to the open-handed the search for one who shall receive is joy greater than giving.

units.source_en: And to the open-handed the search for one who shall receive is joy greater than giving.

paragraphs.source_en: Therefore give now, that the season of giving may be yours and not your inheritors’.

units.source_en: Therefore give now, that the season of giving may be yours and not your inheritors’.

paragraphs.source_en: Surely he who is worthy to receive his days and his nights, is worthy of all else from you.

units.source_en: Surely he who is worthy to receive his days and his nights, is worthy of all else from you.

paragraphs.source_en: And he who has deserved to drink from the ocean of life deserves to fill his cup from your little stream.

units.source_en: And he who has deserved to drink from the ocean of life deserves to fill his cup from your little stream.

paragraphs.source_en: And what desert greater shall there be, than that which lies in the courage and the confidence, nay the charity, of receiving?

units.source_en: And what desert greater shall there be, than that which lies in the courage and the confidence, nay the charity, of receiving?

paragraphs.source_en: And who are you that men should rend their bosom and unveil their pride, that you may see their worth naked and their pride unabashed?

units.source_en: And who are you that men should rend their bosom and unveil their pride, that you may see their worth naked and their pride unabashed?

paragraphs.source_en: For in truth it is life that gives unto life—while you, who deem yourself a giver, are but a witness.
